L2: # Find veterinary clinical trials
L3: 
L4: Search veterinary research listings for dogs, cats, horses, and other animals in one free directory. Every listing links to its source so you can follow up with the institution conducting the study.
L5: 
L6: 【4†Clinical trials for dogs】【5†Clinical trials for cats】【6†Clinical trials for horses】
L7: ## What are veterinary clinical trials?
L8: 
L9: Veterinary clinical trials are research studies involving animals. They evaluate treatments, diagnostic tests, medical devices, or procedures to answer questions about animal health. Participation does not guarantee a benefit for an individual animal.
L10: Discuss a study with your veterinarian and the research team before deciding whether to take part. Ask about eligibility, possible risks, costs, and required visits. Cornell's 【7†clinical trial questions and answers†www.vet.cornell.edu】 explain what to consider.
L11: ## How to search VetTrials
L12:   1. Start with a species above or type a condition or treatment into the search box. For example, search for 【8†lymphoma】.
L13:   2. Narrow the results by condition, state, institution, or listed enrollment status. On a phone, tap Show Filters. You can also browse 【9†dog oncology trials】, 【10†cat kidney trials】, or 【6†horse trials】.
L14:   3. Open a listing and follow its institution link. Confirm whether the study is accepting patients and what participation involves. A Recruiting label in this directory is not confirmation of an available place.
L15: VetTrials is an independent discovery tool, not an enrolling institution. Listings can be out of date or contain errors. VetTrials is not affiliated with the American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) or the institutions listed here. Read more 【3†about VetTrials】.
L16: 
L17: VetTrials aggregates clinical trial listings from 30+ veterinary institutions.Not a substitute for veterinary advice.

L20: Clinical trials and collaborative research in surgical oncology are actively encouraged by the VSSO. L4: # Egy új esély a felépülésre!

L9: ## Bemutatkozás
L10: 
L11: 【1†Image: Dr. Jankovics István】 Dr. Jankovics István
L12: ( ✝ 2024 )
L13: 
L14: Az innovatív daganatellenes terápiák közé sorolható a LISANEXT autológ immunterápiás tumorvakcina, amely hatásmechanizmusát tekintve eltér a klasszikus kemoterápiás kezelésektől. Megfelelő tudással alkalmazva, ez a technológia tumormentes állapot létrejöttét eredményezheti még azokban az esetekben is, amikor a klasszikus onkoterápiákkal nem kezelhetők a betegek.
L15: Daganatos megbetegedésben szenvedőknél – legyen szó akár emberről vagy háziállatokról – az általános állapot javulását, vagy éppen a daganatos megbetegedésből való teljes felgyógyulást, nagyrészt a négy alapmodalitás, a sugárterápia, a kemoterápia, a sebészi beavatkozások, és az immunrendszer stimulációja, továbbá ezek kombinációi hozhatják létre. A sebészeti beavatkozás tumormentes állapotot eredményez, ha a rosszindulatú daganat lokalizált és eltávolítható.
L16: Előrehaladott stádiumú daganatos betegségben, amikor a tumor már betör a nyirok vagy vérkeringésbe és a betegség gyakorlatilag az egész szervezetet érinti, a sebészeti beavatkozással már nem lehet daganatmentes állapotot elérni. A műtétet kiegészítő adjuváns kemo/radioterápiával, valamint egyéb gyógyszeres kezeléssel csökkenthető csak a tumorterhelés, ám a daganatsejtek teljes mértékben többnyire nem pusztíthatók el, a betegség az esetek nagy részében nem gyógyítható meg.

L23: ## Clinical Trials
L24: 
L25: Clinical trials are research studies that investigate new treatments or new ways of using existing treatments. They are necessary to advance the field of veterinary oncology and develop more effective and safer cancer treatments.
L26: At The Cancer Vet, we offer participation in clinical trials, providing your pet with access to innovative treatments that may not be available elsewhere. Our team follows rigorous protocols to ensure the safety and well-being of your pet throughout the trial.
L27: You can leverage our clinical trials by discussing with our team whether your pet is a suitable candidate for any ongoing trials. Participation in a clinical trial can provide your pet with access to cutting-edge treatments and contribute to the advancement of veterinary oncology.
L28: 
L29:  The Cancer Vet passionately delivers specialized comprehensive cancer care for pets, aiming to enhance their quality of life.

L0: # Trials clinici in Oncologia Veterinaria
L1: 
L2: Al fine di far progredire la conoscenza sulle malattie oncologiche che colpiscono i nostri animali da compagnia, i medici veterinari che operano presso l’Ospedale Veterinario dell’Università di Bologna conducono studi clinici volti a valutare l’efficacia di nuove indagini diagnostiche e strategie terapeutiche. Queste scoperte possono spesso essere applicate alla medicina in tutte le specie.
L3: La maggior parte delle ricerche condotte presso il nostro Ospedale si basa sull’applicazione clinica di protocolli innovativi e promettenti sulla base di dati preliminari ottenuti in laboratorio. L’inclusione nello studio consente al paziente di ricevere, a basso costo, un trattamento potenzialmente vantaggioso e superiore rispetto alla terapia attualmente disponibile, con risvolti positivi anche per i futuri malati.
L4: Tutti gli studi clinici sono avviati solo dopo il ricevimento di un parere favorevole da parte del Comitato Etico-Scientifico dell’Università.
L5: Il personale medico discute con il proprietario dell’animale i requisiti necessari all’arruolamento in uno specifico protocollo di ricerca, elencandone i vantaggi, i rischi e le opportunità per quel paziente specifico. In caso di inclusione nello studio, il proprietario provvede alla firma di un consenso informato alle indagini e ai trattamenti sul proprio animale.
L6: ### Trials clinici attualmente in corso che prevedono l’arruolamento di pazienti
